items.title: Japan
kv: The completed September 14 Japan Monetary Constitution remains the deeper monetary owner. The October recertification adds the forum and roadmap, Coincheck registration, PIP-4, exact JPYSC scale, lending-loss transformation, 43-bank experiment population and BOJ wholesale sandbox. The 3 October XRP Asia delta adds a Tokyo ecosystem-support node while preserving the separate SBI Ripple Asia, provider, permission and settlement records. The October 14 Accounting Transition evidence note separately owns Japan's quarterly common-loan-data workflow and published analytical uses: shared granular evidence can support distinct governed views without establishing blockchain, real-time journals or a common general ledger. Open questions include current reserve composition, open-wallet use, selected cross-bank settlement model, production cross-border reversal, observed digital-claim failure, exact replaced reporting templates and measured burden outcomes.
Later product, reserve, rulebook, transaction and failure evidence may change this normalized projection without superseding the deeper owner.
